newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: India said not to block Pakistan in Ocean body.
newsitem.headline: India said not to block Pakistan in Ocean body.

text.p: India has promised not to block Pakistan's bid for membership of the Indian Ocean Rim Association for Regional Co-operation, its current chairman said on Friday.

"Indian Foreign Minister (Inder Kumar) Gujral told me during my recent visit to New Delhi that India will not stand in the way of Pakistan joining the association," Mauritius Deputy Prime Minister Paul Raymond Berenger told a news conference.

Berenger was asked whether he was not worried that the animosity between India and Pakistan, which has slowed progress in the South Asian Association for Regional Co-operation, could disrupt the Indian Ocean Rim initiative.
The Indian Ocean Rim body will confine itself to economic co-operation and not discuss political or military matters, he said.
Berenger, who is also Foreign Affairs Minister, said he visited India and Pakistan before arriving in Colombo on Thursday on a three-day visit.
"Pakistan has been knocking at the door of our association," he said. "No one is willing to see them waiting for a minute more than necessary."
France, Iran, Bangladesh, Egypt, Thailand and Singapore had also applied for membership of the 14-nation body, he said.
